newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse higher, volumes modest.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse higher, volumes modest.

text.p: Most Bucharest shares edged higher at the second weekly session on Thursday, but thin investor interest kept volumes light and sent turnover down.
Overall turnover dived 21 million lei to 32.9 million.
"With both investors and shareholders in a sluggish mood, volumes fell to 6,847 shares from more than 8,000 the previous session," one trader said.
Newcomer Impact SA, a private construction company, failed to arouse buying interest.

"Investors were simply probing into Impact today, but interest in this company will mount because it is privately held and operates in a sector which boasts great potential in Romania," said another trader.
Impact had four transactions in which 49 shares changed hands at an average price of 8,327 lei. It closed at 8,800 lei, up from an opening price of 8,000.
The exchange now trades 14 stocks, of which only Impact and syringe maker Sanevit SA are privately owned.
State fertiliser maker Azomures SA, seen as the bourse's most liquid company, had 17.9 million lei in turnover. It gained 200 lei to close at 10,900.

The VAB unofficial value-weighted index, computed by Vanguard SA securities, closed 1.7 percent higher from the previous session at 292.8 points. The other indepedent index, the BIG, was not available.
